literature_evidence.citation: Kok RN et al. OrganoidTracker 2.0: an algorithm for tracking cells in 3D organoids. Nature Methods. 2025.
literature_evidence.reported_result: The method learns 3-D center, link and division probabilities, calibrates link/division probabilities, and reports less than 0.5% errors per cell per frame in organoid lineage tracking.
literature_evidence.task_relevance: A shared crop encoder can resolve image ambiguity that point features miss, while explicit no-link examples and held-fit calibration target the observed background and cross-video precision failures.

hypothesis.observed_failure_mode: Geometry and NCC cannot separate a small number of true extended-radius links from millions of background proposals.
hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: A small shared 3-D crop encoder compares source and target appearance with relative motion context, then an explicit no-link head and disjoint-fit calibration enforce abstention.
hypothesis.falsification_test: On the frozen 105/12 fit-only split, reject unless calibrated precision reaches 0.95 on both families, capped utility beats pair-NCC by at least 5, and calibration error improves over the raw head.

early_stop_conditions: Stop on any memory, free-memory, or swap guard violation.
Stop if validation precision is below 0.93 overall or for either family.
Stop if held-fit calibration does not reduce calibration error.
Stop if crop IO or measured throughput cannot complete a useful continuation inside seven hours.
success_criteria: Grouped out-of-fold and held-fit validation precision are at least 0.95.
Validation capped utility is at least 5 above the exact pair-NCC control.
Utility change is non-negative on both families.
Held-fit calibration improves calibration error over the raw head.
Uncertain sparse-label pairs are masked rather than assigned as negatives.

decision_basis: Coordinator pre-training gate review: primary peer-reviewed 3-D link-network evidence, explicit fit-only 105/12 falsification, 10 GiB projected peak, 90-minute pilot cap, held-fit calibration requirement, uncertain-pair masking, and no-holdout/no-swap constraints satisfy compute_governance_v1. PASS authorizes only data auditing and a guarded local fit-only pilot; it does not authorize CV57, Kaggle, GPU, or RunPod work.
